stages.headline: To add numbers of the same sign, add their moduli and keep the sign: −3 + (−4) is 4 steps left of −3.
stages.headlineEnglish: To add numbers of the same sign, add their moduli and keep the sign: −3 + (−4) is 4 steps left of −3.

stages.headline: To add numbers of different signs, subtract the smaller modulus from the larger and take the sign of the larger.
stages.headlineEnglish: To add numbers of different signs, subtract the smaller modulus from the larger and take the sign of the larger.

stages.headline: The sum of opposites is 0, and adding 0 changes nothing.
